description_en: Queries the status of one or more jobs submitted to clear or delete a media fingerprint library (FpDB)
name: QueryFpDBDeleteJobList

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the jobs to query. You can get job IDs from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209341.html operation. To query multiple jobs, separate the IDs with a comma (,). If you omit this parameter, the operation returns the 20 most recent jobs
parameters.help_zh: 清空或删除DNA库作业ID，可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209341.html的返回参数中获取。以半角逗号（,）分隔，如果为空则返回最近20个作业列表
parameters.name: job_ids
